newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 3-year floater T-notes Friday.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 3-year floater T-notes Friday.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will offer 35 billion levs of three-year, floating interest T-notes with no minimum acceptable price set in advance at an auction on Friday, the central bank said.
Interest on the paper was set at four percentage points above the central bank annual main interest rate for the period to maturity and would be adjusted each time the main rate changes.
The central bank on Thursday cut its main rate to 5.2 percent monthly or 62.4 percent annually, from 6.2 percent monthly or 74.4 percent annually, to be effective from Monday, May 12.
Coupon payments are due semi-annually until maturity. Principal is due at maturity together with the last coupon payment.
